name: Massachusetts

creditorClaims.text: Not verified: M.G.L. c. 190B § 3-803 (limitations on presentation of claims) could not be read from an official source.

earliestClose.text: Outside supervised administration, an estate may be closed by verified statement no earlier than 6 months after original appointment, after the time for presenting claims has expired (M.G.L. c. 190B § 3-1003(a)).

smallEstate.text: Voluntary administration by verified statement filed with the Probate and Family Court, 30 days after death, when the estate consists entirely of personal property not exceeding $25,000 in value plus a motor vehicle (M.G.L. c. 190B § 3-1201). Not indexed.

simplified.text: Voluntary administration for personal property up to $25,000 plus a car (§ 3-1201); summary administration when the estate does not exceed allowances, administration and funeral and last-illness expenses (M.G.L. c. 190B § 3-1203).

filingFee.text: Probate and Family Court: petition for formal or informal probate of a will and/or appointment of a personal representative $375 plus $15 surcharge; general probate petition $150 plus $15; subsequent letter $25.

personalRepFee.text: Not verified: M.G.L. c. 190B § 3-719 could not be read; no statutory percentage schedule is known from the sections read.
